verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents an official MCP server guide that lets users run browser automation tasks from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf or any MCP client, and the probe confirms the guide exists at the official docs URL. One community comment said browser-use lacked MCP integration in Cursor, but it reads as an older statement of absence rather than a hands-on failure of the documented server, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: details on setup, authentication and the exposed tool list, plus independent hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Run browser automation tasks from your AI coding assistant. Connect to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client.
